name: FutaCity
source: Follow the story of Sota, a short-statured boy who returns to the Chiba family home (you can define your relationship with each member of the family) after spending five years abroad. He was a bit afraid to return home after discovering, just days before leaving, the big secret the Chiba family had been hiding.
translation: 讲述身材矮小的男孩Sota在国外呆了五年后回到千叶家的故事（你可以定义与每个家庭成员的关系）。就在离开前几天，他发现千叶家族一直隐藏的大秘密后，他有点不敢回家。
